mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.spot_name, p.area_tag, p.visit_status, p.body, p.image_path, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.visibility, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username, u.display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS like_count

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes liked WHERE liked.post_id = p.id AND liked.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS liked_by_me, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites fav WHERE fav.post_id = p.id AND fav.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS favorited_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id

choose.when: AND p.visibility = 'public' AND p.image_path IS NOT NULL AND p.image_path != ''

mapper.select: SELECT , 0 AS liked_by_me, 0 AS favorited_by_me FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts ( user_id, spot_name, area_tag, visit_status, body, image_path, latitude, longitude, visibility, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, COALESCE(#{spotName}, '未設定'), COALESCE(#{areaTag}, '関東'), COALESCE(#{visitStatus}, 'visited'), #{body}, #{imagePath}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, COALESCE(#{visibility}, 'public'), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR)) )
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET spot_name = #{spotName}, area_tag = #{areaTag}, visit_status = #{visitStatus}, body = #{body}, image_path = #{imagePath}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, visibility = COALESCE(#{visibility}, 'public'), updated_at = CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS VARCHAR) WHERE id = #{id}
